{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==

* 1 head of green [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] and/or [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Parsley|Parsley]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* Grated [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|Cayenne pepper]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], roughly chopped
* Salt

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the cabbage until tender. Drain.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the chopped bacon in butter.
# Combine the cooked cabbage, bacon, parsley, egg, cheese, cayenne, and chopped onion. Season to taste with salt.
# Transfer mixture to a glass [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 15 minutes at 180˚C.
# Serve with toasted bread.
